candidates.name: Yaekatsu
candidates.why: The locals' kushikatsu in Shinsekai: lighter, potato-softened batter, cheap sticks and lager in a loud old-Osaka counter room. Better than queuing for the tourist branches.
candidates.best_time: Weekday 10:30–12:00 or 15:00–17:00 to dodge the queue; pair with Shinsekai/Tsutenkaku and Chitose nearby
candidates.dates: Closed Thursdays (so not Thu 24 Dec); open Tue 22, Wed 23, Fri 25
candidates.price: Roughly ¥2,000–3,000 a head with beer; cash
candidates.group_of_8: Counter only: 8 will be split into 2–3 groups or wait for adjacent seats; queue moves fast

evidence.note: Long-running Shinsekai kushikatsu, consistently ranked among Osaka's best
Called a local favourite with queues; batter softened with potato (Fun Japan https://www.fun-japan.jp/en/articles/1525)

candidates.name: Kushikatsu Daruma Shinsekai Honten
candidates.name_ja: 串かつだるま 新世界総本店
candidates.why: The original 1929 kushikatsu shop with the angry-chef mascot and the 'no double dipping' rule. The classic photo stop; food is good, not the best.
candidates.best_time: Late afternoon before the Shinsekai neon comes on
candidates.group_of_8: Honten is a tiny counter; for 8 use one of Daruma's larger Shinsekai/Dotonbori branches, which have tables

evidence.note: Founding shop, branch list incl. bigger Dotonbori/Namba shops

candidates.name: Chitose (okonomiyaki & nikusui)
candidates.why: Birthplace of nikusui (beef-broth hangover soup) and a beloved neighbourhood okonomiyaki/yakisoba spot, 5 min walk from Shinsekai. Real Osaka, cheap, great the morning after.
candidates.best_time: Lunch around 11:30 on Thu 24 or Fri 25, then walk to Shinsekai
candidates.dates: Closed Tue and Wed (so not 22–23 Dec); open Mon, Thu, Fri, Sat
candidates.booking: No reservations; expect a line at lunch
candidates.group_of_8: Small dining room; 8 may be seated in two goes

evidence.note: Shop page for the nikusui originator

candidates.name: Takoyaki Wanaka Sennichimae Honten
candidates.name_ja: たこ焼道楽 わなか 千日前本店
candidates.why: The safest great takoyaki in Minami: crisp-outside, molten inside, with the 'osenbei' rice-cracker sandwich option. Quick stand-up snack between Namba stops.
candidates.booking: No; takeaway window plus some seats
candidates.group_of_8: Takeaway works for any group size

candidates.name: Yakiniku Sora Tsuruhashi Honten
candidates.name_ja: 焼肉 空 鶴橋本店
candidates.why: Tsuruhashi's horumon-and-yakiniku queue shop: small cheap plates so 8 people can order everything. Smoky, loud, exactly the Tsuruhashi experience.
candidates.best_time: Open at 11:00 or go before 17:00; pair with Korea Town street food
candidates.price: Horumon plates ~¥500–850; budget ~¥3,000–4,000 a head with drinks
candidates.booking: Queue; check the official site for reservations

evidence.note: Described as a constant-queue shop with small, cheap portions; horumon ~¥500–850 a plate

candidates.name: Osaka Ikuno Korea Town (Tsuruhashi)
candidates.name_ja: 大阪生野コリアタウン
candidates.why: Japan's biggest Korea Town: hotteok, tteokbokki, Korean fried chicken and cheese dogs at street prices. Locals' alternative to over-priced Dotonbori snacks.
candidates.best_time: Daytime 11:00–17:00 (most stalls close early evening); combine with Sora for horumon
candidates.dates: Street always open; individual shops vary, many quiet one weekday

evidence.note: 'Dotonbori is overpriced' – Korea Town as the locals' street-food alternative, 8 min from Namba

candidates.name: Kuromon Market
candidates.why: Osaka's kitchen: grilled scallops, tuna, wagyu skewers, strawberries. Fun to graze, but now tourist-priced; skip the crab and eat small things.
candidates.best_time: 9:00–11:00 as a grazing breakfast, before the crowds
candidates.dates: Open 21–26 Dec; some stalls close Sundays
candidates.group_of_8: Walk-and-graze; eat at the stalls' seating

evidence.note: 'Don't go to Kuromon Market for crab' – points to better-value crab elsewhere

candidates.name: Harukoma Sushi (main store)
candidates.why: Big, fresh nigiri at local prices in Japan's longest shopping arcade. The best-value sushi of the stay; then crawl the Tenma izakaya alleys.
candidates.best_time: Weekday 15:00–17:00 (gap between lunch and dinner queues)
candidates.group_of_8: Counter: you'll be seated in smaller groups

evidence.note: #1 of '5 local food spots': fresh, generous sushi at reasonable prices

candidates.name: Robatayaki Homuraya
candidates.why: Fukushima's viral robata: scallops in butter, whole squid, prawns and skewers grilled in front of you, almost everything ¥300 including drinks. Perfect budget start to a Fukushima crawl.
candidates.best_time: Open at 17:00, then hop the Fukushima back-alleys
candidates.price: Most food and drinks ~¥300; ~¥3,000 a head with drinks
candidates.booking: Check official site / phone; book a table for 8

evidence.note: 'Everything ¥300 is a bug' – scallop butter, squid, prawns, turban shell all ¥300, steps from JR Fukushima

candidates.name: Jizakana Yatai Tottsuan Fukushima
candidates.name_ja: 地魚屋台 とっつぁん 福島店
candidates.why: Rowdy under-the-tracks fish izakaya: ¥109 sushi and tempura, sashimi platters, good for a big table. Cheap, takes groups, open to midnight.
candidates.booking: Reservable via usual Japanese sites; book for 8

evidence.note: Address OK2番街 under JR Fukushima; ¥109 sushi/tempura; 5-kind sashimi ¥1,628; hours

candidates.name: Sakanaya Juggler Tenma
candidates.name_ja: 魚屋 ジャグラー 天満
candidates.why: Cheap fish izakaya open to 3am and takes reservations: the Tenma stop that works for 8 and late.
candidates.best_time: 21:00 onwards as a late dinner after Tenma standing bars
candidates.group_of_8: Reservable; ask for a table for 8

evidence.note: 'Prices so cheap you look five times'; budget ¥3,000; reservations OK; 18:00–03:00, no closing day

candidates.name: Yakiniku Rikimaru Umeda Ohatsutenjin
candidates.name_ja: 焼肉 力丸 梅田お初天神店
candidates.why: Budget all-you-can-eat yakiniku with all-you-can-drink add-on: the easy, cheap yakiniku night for 8 hungry 20-year-olds, open to midnight.
candidates.price: All-you-can-eat from about ¥3,300 (90 min, 2023 price); drinks plan extra
candidates.booking: Book online (Hot Pepper/Gurunavi); coupons for groups

evidence.note: 82 kinds of yakiniku AYCE ¥3,278 (90 min) at the chain

candidates.name: Kinryu Ramen Dotonbori
candidates.name_ja: 金龍ラーメン 道頓堀店
candidates.why: 24-hour dragon-sign ramen with free kimchi and rice: not the best ramen, but the place to end the night in Minami at 3am.

candidates.name: Endo Sushi (Central Market)
candidates.name_ja: ゑんどう寿司 中央市場店
candidates.why: Market-fresh sushi breakfast from 6:15 inside Osaka's central fish market, 10 minutes by taxi from Kujō. The best breakfast in the city.
candidates.dates: Mon–Sat; closed Sundays and market holidays — check the market calendar
candidates.group_of_8: Small counter/tables; may seat in 2 groups

evidence.note: Central market branch plus Kyobashi branch
4.4 from 2,362; recent reviewers mention ¥1,400–1,980 per plate and uncertainty over open days

candidates.name: Marufuku Coffee Sennichimae Honten
candidates.name_ja: 丸福珈琲店 千日前本店
candidates.why: 1934 kissaten for a retro coffee, thick toast and pancakes before Kuromon or Namba shopping.

candidates.name: Nishiki Market
candidates.why: Kyoto's 400m food street: tamagoyaki, soy-milk donuts, tako tamago, pickles. The one Kyoto food stop worth building a Kyoto day around.
candidates.group_of_8: Walk-and-graze; eat at the stall (no eating while walking)

notes: Osaka · food: Pair by area: Shinsekai + Chitose (Nishinari) + Tsutenkaku for a day. Chitose is shut Tue/Wed and Yaekatsu is shut Thu 24 Dec, so do it Fri 25. Tsuruhashi (Sora + Korea Town) is a daytime pairing; Korea Town stalls close by ~18:00. Minami: Marufuku/Kuromon morning, Wanaka snack, Kinryu as the 24h closer (w2). Fukushima (Homuraya ¥300 robata, Tottsuan) is the nearest izakaya strip to Kujō: Hanshin one stop to Nishikujō, then JR loop two stops. Tenma (Harukoma, Juggler to 3am) is the other crawl, also on the JR loop. Breakfast near base: Endo Sushi in the Central Wholesale Market (Noda) from 6:15, closed Sun and on market holidays, so check the 休市日 calendar for Tue 22/Wed 23. Christmas Eve/Day are normal business days in Japan; only date-night restaurants book out, izakaya and yakiniku are fine, but book Rikimaru/Tottsuan/Homuraya for 8 on the 24th and 25th. No year-end closures before the 26th. Counter shops (Yaekatsu, Harukoma, Daruma honten, Chitose) will split 8 into twos and threes; use Rikimaru, Tottsuan, Juggler and Homuraya to sit together. Transport: Hanshin Namba line runs from Kujō to Namba directly; an Osaka Metro 1-day Enjoy Eco Card pays off on Shinsekai/Tsuruhashi/Namba days.
